source: RCSB PDB entry metadata, local PDB headers, and UniProt mapping (verified 2026-08-08 via data.rcsb.org and rest.uniprot.org)

PfDHFR.identity: Wild-type Plasmodium falciparum dihydrofolate reductase-thymidylate synthase

PfCRT.identity: Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter 7G8 isoform

PfClpP.old_identity: Plasmodium falciparum ClpR (inactive paralog/subunit), not PfClpP (UniProt Q8IL98; El Bakkouri et al. 2013 'Structural Insights into the Inactive Subunit of the Apicoplast-localized Caseinolytic Protease Complex')
PfClpP.new_identity: Genuine PfClpP catalytic domain (EC 3.4.21.92, UniProt O97252, El Bakkouri et al. 2010 'The Clp chaperones and proteases of the human malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum'; 2.45 A resolution, heptamer chains A-G)
PfClpP.pocket_center_basis: Centroid of catalytic Ser/His/Asp residues across the heptamer (2F6I coordinate frame); the old 4GM2 center (26.19, 35.09, 24.72) is NOT transferable to the 2F6I frame and must not be reused

PfATP4.identity: Plasmodium falciparum P-type ATPase PfATP4/PfABP complex

required_repair: The 17 PfClpP DiffDock poses were generated on 4GM2 (wrong receptor, different coordinate frame) and are unusable: re-run DiffDock on 2F6I for the 17 PfClpP pairs, then re-verify rank-1 IN_GRID containment in the 2F6I pocket box, then independently review all four receptor identities before any new scoring/consensus/RRS/PNS run.
